# SettlementUpkeep

`world-system`

What a village pays to keep going: a cost per tier taken from the stockpile every period. Unpaid upkeep suspends project effects until it is paid; it never shrinks the claim, which still follows only the activity-based abandonment rule. Upkeep never falls as the tier rises.

> Give a growing village a reason to keep gathering and trading (EverythingHasTradeoffs, Phase 197)

## Actions

### pay

Take the tier's upkeep from the stockpile once per periodHours

**Conditions:**
- upkeepRelief effects reduce each quantity, rounded down
- If the stockpile cannot pay in full nothing is taken and project effects are suspended until it can
- Unpaid upkeep never shrinks the claim
